reviews.text: I decided to go with Simmons Family Roofing LLC after seeing all their great reviews and high ratings. They definitely live up to their reputation. From the start, the team was polite and always quick to answer my calls or reply to texts. They were professional every step of the way and kept their promises. The crew used top-quality roofing materials with strong warranties, and the work they did was excellent. They replaced both my shingle and rubber roofs in Lewisville all in one day, and the results look fantastic. Throughout the day, Jamie kept me updated with photos showing the progress on my roof. I couldn’t be more satisfied and highly recommend them to anyone in need of roofing services.
reviews.author: M Hanson

reviews.text: After a big hailstorm, I found out I needed a new roof. Since I had never replaced a roof before, I was worried about the cost and the whole process. I reached out to a few roofing companies and talked with them about my options. I’m really glad I chose this team for the job. They used top-quality materials and their craftsmanship was excellent, all at a fair price. At first, I felt overwhelmed since I didn’t know much about roofing, but Earl and Jamie were incredibly patient and helpful throughout everything. They walked me through different shingle samples and helped me make the right choice—the new shingles look fantastic on my home! If you’re looking for a roofer who is honest, patient, and gets the work done quickly and professionally, I highly recommend this company. They made the whole process easy for me, and I couldn’t be happier with my new roof.
reviews.author: tara morrison

reviews.text: i want to share the great experience i had with a local roofing company. i called them because i noticed a small leak around my bathroom exhaust fan, which was put in by a handyman. the roofing team came out the same afternoon and inspected everything. earl found that the gooseneck vent was not installed right, which was letting water in. that evening, they sent me a quote that was much better than others i had received, so i quickly agreed to move forward. earl explained it was a small repair job and they would try to fit me in between their bigger projects. i thought i might have to wait a while, but just three days later, earl called to say his crew would be there the next day. the roofers arrived on time, were very courteous, and made sure to clean up after themselves. once the work was done, the technician took the time to show me photos of what the previous installation looked like and how they corrected it. they carefully prepped the area, installed the new gooseneck vent properly, and replaced the shingles. i highly recommend this roofing company for any repairs or roof work you need. they’re quick, professional, and really know what they’re doing—especially in our hot texas weather!
reviews.author: patrick griffith

reviews.text: I hired a roofing company to replace my roof, and I was very impressed with their service from start to finish. After the job was done, Jamie, the owner, noticed that some of the shingles looked darker than the others. Jamie immediately contacted the shingle manufacturer and arranged for their representative to come out and inspect the roof. It turned out that the shingles had come from two different plants, which explained the color difference. The manufacturer suggested waiting a few months to see if the sun and Texas weather would help even out the colors. After that time, the manufacturer decided to replace the entire roof at no extra cost. Jamie took care of everything and made sure that not only the shingles but also all the other roofing materials were replaced. I was even able to choose a new shingle color, which I really appreciated. The whole team was professional, attentive, and made the process easy for me. I highly recommend this roofing company to anyone looking for quality work and great customer service.
reviews.author: ellie alvarado

reviews.text: The roofing team helped us by taking clear pictures of the hail damage on our roof and sent them straight to our insurance company, which made the claim process much easier. The crew arrived on time and completed the entire roof replacement in just one day, even with the Texas heat. The workmanship was solid and the crew made sure to keep the area safe from falling debris. When they finished, they cleaned up everything really well. About a week after the roof was done, Earl, the crew boss, and an inspector came back to check their work. They had also replaced our skylight, which was a bit off center at first, but they quickly sent out another contractor to add molding inside, making it look much better. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the roofing service. I would definitely use them again and have already recommended them to friends in Lewisville.
reviews.author: Olivia Shaffer

reviews.text: We recently had some roof damage and needed repairs, so we decided to go with a local roofing company. Earl was our main contact and made the whole process smooth from start to finish. Even though I had some concerns because of the company’s older online reviews, Earl explained that they’re under new management now and working hard to improve things. Based on our experience, I can definitely say they delivered on that promise. Earl kept us informed at every stage. He helped us deal with our insurance company, made sure the roofing crew showed up on time, and even handled delays when some supplies were late by getting documentation from the distributor. Earl also sent updates to the insurance company with order and delivery details, which made everything easier. After each part of the job, he followed up to make sure we were happy. We had our shingles, siding, doors, and windows replaced, and the finished work looks fantastic. Earl really knew what products would hold up best in the Texas heat and suggested smart upgrades, like adding flashing above the garage to protect the wood from water. The roofing crew did an excellent job, worked efficiently, and left our yard clean—just a few stray nails, which is normal for construction. They were friendly, even taking a moment to play with our dogs. We’re very happy with how everything turned out and would definitely use Earl and his team again for roofing or exterior home projects. This review is simply because I’m a satisfied customer and want to share our positive experience.
reviews.author: Miles Brooks

reviews.text: I am very thankful for the outstanding work and service I received from Simmons Family Roofing LLC. When a major leak appeared in my son's room, I contacted them right away. Earl understood how urgent the situation was and got a crew out to my house in Lewisville quickly—within just a day and a half. This happened during a stretch of heavy rain, so their fast response really saved my home from more water damage. The team was quick, professional, and gave me a fair price for the roof repair. I will definitely call on them again for any roofing needs in the future!
reviews.author: Aurora Obrien

reviews.text: From the very beginning, my experience with the roofing team was excellent. Landon got back to me quickly, even though I called on a holiday, and showed up right on time for our appointment to look at my home in Lewisville for a roof leak. He really knew his stuff and was able to pinpoint exactly where the issue was coming from. I took the time to get quotes from several other roofing companies, but even though Landon’s estimate was a little higher, I felt the most confident choosing him. His honesty and attention to detail made me trust that he would do the job right, which is the most important thing. On the day of the repair, one of Landon’s crew, Jamie, arrived early and immediately got to work. Landon also came by and stayed on-site, just like he said he would. They went above and beyond, doing more than we originally discussed, just to make sure everything was fixed properly. Landon stood by his word and provided a five-year warranty on the work, which really put my mind at ease. I highly recommend this roofing team to anyone in Lewisville needing help with roof repairs or any roofing work. I will definitely call them again for future roofing needs.
reviews.author: Michael Gould

reviews.text: After many years of being a homeowner, I can confidently say that this roofing crew is the best I’ve worked with. Landon and the team handled everything for me—from installing a rubber roof and shingle roof to replacing the chimney and doing all the flashing work. Their attention to detail is impressive, especially when it comes to their metal work. They designed and built a custom stainless steel chimney cover that has caught the eye of all my neighbors here in Lewisville. The copper flashing they installed around the chimney looks fantastic and feels like it will last for decades. They also did copper flashing by my basement door, which turned out just as great. If you need roofing work done in this area, this company is the clear choice.
reviews.author: A Kramer

reviews.text: We got in touch with a local roofing company at a home show in Lewisville. Unlike others we talked to, there was no pressure to set up an appointment or give out our personal contact information. After getting quotes from a few different roofers, we decided to go with this company for several reasons. We met with Jamie, one of the owners, who was friendly and explained everything clearly about roofing materials, gutters, scheduling, and payment options. The customer service from Jamie, the foreman Earl, and the whole roofing crew was outstanding. They really take care of their customers and make you feel valued. I highly recommend this roofing company to anyone in Lewisville needing roof repairs or a new roof. The work was finished quickly and the company is definitely in good hands.
reviews.author: B Benton

reviews.text: After a big storm in Lewisville, we noticed shingles missing from our yard and decided to have our roof checked. Simmons Family Roofing LLC sent out Landon and Jamie, who did a full inspection of our roof and property. They found wind and hail damage we didn’t even realize we had. They shared detailed hail reports and clear pictures of the issues they found, which really helped us understand what was going on. Landon and Jamie explained the insurance claim process step by step, making it easy to see why filing a claim for storm damage made sense instead of paying for everything ourselves. Once we let them know when our insurance adjuster was coming, they came out to meet them and helped us through the inspection. Thanks to their help, we got approved for a full roof and gutter replacement. The installation went smoothly—they arrived on time, finished the job in a single day, and left the place clean. We’re very happy with our new roof and definitely recommend them to anyone in need of roofing services in Lewisville.
reviews.author: Keith Mahoney

reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about Simmons Family Roofing LLC. We have an asphalt shingle roof with some slope, plus a flat rubber roof, and both were replaced in just one day. Nolan gave me the estimate for the work. He and his supervisor, Earl, were there from the beginning, even bringing a dump trailer the night before so everything went smoothly in the morning. The crew, which had about 12 roofers, arrived at 7am and by around 8am, both roofs were already taken off. They replaced any damaged boards, then installed new shingles and put on a new rubber roof. They also added new flashing around both chimneys and fixed the aluminum fascia where it was needed, all by 3pm. The whole team worked together like pros. I am really impressed with the quality of their work and how much pride they take in doing a great job. You can tell they care when they're taking photos of their work at the end. The price was very reasonable, and everyone was polite, tidy, on time, and worked super hard. I highly recommend them to anyone in Lewisville needing roofing work.
reviews.author: Claire Juarez

reviews.text: We recently had a new roof installed at our home in Lewisville. From the first call to the final cleanup, the whole team was knowledgeable and friendly. Earl and the rest of the crew worked hard the entire time, making sure everything was done right. Even when they had to wait for more shingles to arrive for our garage, they kept busy by picking up debris, looking for stray nails or staples, and using a blower to clean off our sidewalk, pergola, and carport. They really went the extra mile to make sure everything was spotless. I would definitely recommend this roofing company to anyone needing roofing services in Lewisville!
reviews.author: Stacy Jennings

reviews.text: This roofing company did an outstanding job on my home in Lewisville. They were honest, skilled, and took care of everything I needed. The team put a brand new roof on my house, added a vent for my bathroom, wrapped all my windows, and replaced the fascia and soffits. They also installed new gutters and updated the siding on both my house and garage. I even had them put new plywood walls in my garage. Landon, who was my production manager, went above and beyond throughout the whole project. He answered all my questions, addressed any concerns, and made sure everything went smoothly from start to finish. Landon is definitely a great part of their team. Since the work was finished, I have received many compliments on how nice my house looks. I’m so happy I chose this company for my roofing and exterior work. If you need roofing or exterior services in Lewisville, I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Ryan Mcdaniel

reviews.text: Nolan with Simmons Family Roofing LLC was a pleasure to work with. Our church in Lewisville had been planning to get a new roof on the south side. At first, we thought about doing the work ourselves and started buying shingles and other supplies. I suggested we look into having professionals handle the roofing instead. After talking it over and doing some research, we decided to go with Nolan and his crew. From the very start, Nolan was helpful and took time to explain what roofing materials we needed before the job began. The whole process was simple, and the team showed up early and worked in an organized way. They were careful around the church and cleaned up all the old roofing material, even using magnets to pick up stray nails. When we needed two extra plywood boards, Nolan and Earl took the time to go out and bring back exactly what was needed to finish the job. The work was professional and the price was very fair. We are very happy with the results!
reviews.author: Max Jones

reviews.text: Simmons Family Roofing LLC did a fantastic job with the shingle roof replacement on our mobile home. I was particularly taken aback by the outstanding service from Earl, who provided our quote, Jamie, who ensured all jobs are well-supplied and run smoothly, and Nolan, our crew leader. Jamie made certain that all my contract requests were fulfilled and went the extra mile to be of help. He was also quite supportive when I needed to see larger examples of the shingle colors. Earl, who is quite knowledgeable, could improve in terms of follow-up but he does have quite a load to manage. With a bit of prompting, they managed to wrap up the job within three weeks of contract signing. What impressed us the most was that the crew arrived at 7:30 AM and completely finished an 11 square roof by noon. The clean-up was done efficiently and most crucially, the roof withstood heavy rainfall a few days later without a single leak. There was a small leak around a vent and Earl came out instantly to inspect it. He couldn't identify any issues with the roofing but decided to install a brand new larger vent. Earl went above and beyond to find one that matched the color of the other vents, and Jamie promptly carried out the repair. Earl also helped me find a leak in my metal shed roof last spring and was kind enough to apply some silicone caulk that solved the problem. There's a reason Simmons Family Roofing LLC has a solid five-star rating, and it's their superior customer service. Four other homeowners in Lewisville had their roofs done after seeing ours, and they were all as delighted as we were. Thanks to the team, you all truly deserve 10 stars!
reviews.author: Juanita Baird

reviews.text: Just try to remember a time when a service provider communicated efficiently with you...I understand, it's not easy. But, Simmons Family Roofing LLC was present throughout the entire process of my roof replacement after a significant hail storm. They were there not only when the insurance adjuster arrived but also every step of the way. Specifically, Jamie took on the role of my single point of contact with great enthusiasm. A tropical storm and its heavy rainfall was not an issue, and my household manager (wife) was delighted! I highly recommend Simmons Family Roofing LLC for your next roofing service in Lewisville.
reviews.author: Bethany Gates

reviews.text: An ice storm caused serious damage to our roof, leading to water leaking onto our hardwood floors. We reached out to Simmons Family Roofing LLC and got a quick response, even though Nolan was away at the time. A crew arrived within an hour, worked through thick ice, and made temporary repairs right away. The following day, they came back, removed more ice, and completely sealed the leak. The seal has held strong through several heavy storms. Because there was a lot of damage, Nolan recommended replacing the entire roof, and we agreed. The crew spent a few days working on our large roof and made sure everything was tidy and handled professionally. We also had them add extra insulating foam for better energy efficiency. We highly recommend this company for any roofing needs.
reviews.author: Dennis25 Z

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The 4.8 Google rating is supported by detailed, specific reviews from customers in Lewisville. Reviews mention real team members, specific project types (shingle/rubber roofs, mobile homes, chimney work), and credible scenarios (hail damage, insurance claims, follow-up inspections). The few 3-4 star reviews are positive but measured, adding credibility. The cluster of reviews from 3-4 months ago could indicate a post-storm service surge rather than fakery.
fake_signals: Multiple reviews posted same day (3 months ago)
Some reviews have similar, slightly generic opening phrases

positive_evidence: Owner arranged manufacturer inspection for shingle color issue
Crew boss returned for follow-up inspection
Use of top-quality materials with strong warranties

authentic_signals: Specific project details (Lewisville, shingle/rubber roofs, hail damage, bathroom exhaust fan leak)
Mention of specific team members (Earl, Jamie, Landon, Nolan)
3-4 star reviews provide balanced, credible feedback
Details about insurance claim assistance and follow-up inspections
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available, showing a consistent high rating. No other platforms have ratings to compare.
